summary: Combine service capabilities into a normalized stack inventory
description: Aggregate available adapter output into a stable inventory with explicit unknown, unsupported, unreachable, and partial states.
acceptance: Inventory preserves service-level evidence and uncertainty.
Partial service availability does not become an all-green stack claim.
Serialized inventory contains no credentials or raw private responses.
All five adapters contribute to one normalized inventory in the real local lab.
The healthy baseline and partial availability are proven through focused real-lab smoke tests.
